request.description: GET /api/user/getAllServices — CUSTOMER SERVICE CATALOG (auth optional). PRE-ADDRESS (no ?latitude/?longitude/?zoneId/?districtId + no usable customer default address, incl. logged-out and Technician — technicians have NO default address): returns ALL active services + availabilityPrompt. POST-ADDRESS (explicit location params or customer default address): zone-filtered, District + Zone both required. Explicit point outside all polygons => [] "No services available in your area". Inactive/invalid zone => [] "Services are currently unavailable in this area". Supports ?search & ?categoryId. Technician tokens get pricing hidden. Booking gates unchanged.
